name: Starfire Barrage replaces Starfire Shot, and Drawstring of Elune does not
contract: aura_ascension_starcaller_lifecycle::Apply swapped the Starfire Shot button on two different auras. 572319 'Starfire Barrage [Proc]' is the correct one: Starfire Barrage 802682 is a ranged shot (DmgClass 3, RangeIndex 113, EquippedItemSubClassMask 262156) whose tooltip reads 'Scales with modifiers to Starfire Shot'. 803573 'Drawstring of Elune [SLS]' was the wrong one: it swapped in 801975, which is the Drawstring of Elune ability itself, a 120000 ms cooldown self buff (RangeIndex 1, DmgClass 1, effects granting a proc, SPELLMOD_RANGE and a dummy) that the Starcaller already owns as its own spellbook entry (mod-spellbook SpellbookTreeSpellData {26, 801975}), so the shot button became a duplicate of that cooldown. Among every SpellFamilyName 32 spell named Starfire or Drawstring only 802682 is a ranged shot, so no third variant was intended. The swap itself also never applied: Replace calls Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement, which returns early unless HasActiveSpell holds for both the original and the replacement, and 802682 has no acquisition path at all (absent from AscensionCompatData::ClassSpells, trainer_spell and ascension_custom_class_spell). Apply now learns it with learnSpell(..., true) for PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY knowledge before calling Replace, and Remove reverts with removeSpell(802682, SPEC_MASK_ALL, true), mirroring the Blade of the Moon bridge for Moonblade 801125 directly above it. Replace matches by rank chain via sSpellMgr->GetFirstSpellInChain, so all eight Starfire Shot ranks are covered; only rank 1 is asserted here. The three stack gate that hands out 572319 in play is covered by its own scenario; this one applies the auras as fixtures.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Starfire Barrage is not known beforehand
SETUP: Starfire Shot is not replaced beforehand
Apply the Drawstring of Elune proc on its own
Drawstring of Elune leaves the Starfire Shot button alone
The Drawstring ability is not learned onto the bar
Starfire Shot is replaced by Starfire Barrage
